title: Implement reusable additive footprint and native-grid batch repairs with consistent drawing, picking and reversible releases

body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-08 (America/Los_Angeles). Parent #1202. One coherent engineering work item, at most three PRs. This is the reusable global repair mechanism; it does not close the worldwide campaign or authorize physical/history claims.

Problem and measured basis
Ordinary floating union can report no subtraction residue yet fail strict coverage. Exact append avoids recomputing old boundaries, but all thirteen retained Alaska append attempts are invalid OGC MultiPolygons. Do not disguise these as valid MultiPolygon/GeometryCollection, buffer, snap, loosen covers, or waive validity. The two already accepted #1295 Canadian old+gain append variants ARE valid, preserve original coordinate arrays, match their accepted native result, and gain 2+1 canonical cells. Fifteen small complete candidate bounding-window measurements took 84.8 ms; no global speed or completion percentage follows. Alaska's hypothetical 139 cells remain unapproved. A positive-area subcell fixture gains zero canonical cells.

Implement and independently review ONE common rule set, not a new approval request for each gap:
- Input a pinned current reference release/owner grid, complete retained candidate records and their original full source/query/context/custody receipts. Derive scope and descriptors independently. Preserve complete original pointsets, source flags/parents/order, reference IDs/pixel indices, labels, historical content, all unknowns and original files/inverses.
- A versioned rule may authorize only its explicitly reviewed original-source-relative land-support mapping scope. Whole retained GSHHG L1/descendant evidence is not contemporary ground truth. Prove complete candidate land support and absence of conflicting source water using existing complete original products; source-frame/invalid/container/domain/registration/date/fitness issues outside the reviewed rule remain exception rows. Never infer outside-L1=dry land. Distinguish preservation of source caveats from actual eligible predicates. A raw mapped-land count or a producer-supplied approval boolean alone is insufficient.
- Derive one existing reference target from independently bound source/admin/reference evidence; ambiguous/missing/foreign targets stay exceptions. Target identity, parent, owner index and historical claims never transfer. Do not introduce location IDs or silently select the nearest/first neighbor.
- Effective baseline means the selected/restored installed canonical bank authenticated by its original release/selection/whole-body receipts, not raw Git geography or a producer-written currentness flag. Concrete trap: tracked historical part 29 has 12,932,167 bytes/SHA prefix077e, while installed v8 part 29 has 12,932,407 bytes/SHA c34114912dc620dce0821e251877470b5a83385ab3bf1284408f077b78bbdec8 and includes the two accepted repairs. Read the selected bank through the existing authenticated restoration consumer, bind all complete actual before-context/owner/release products, preserve old banks at their real vintages, and reject stale/foreign selection. Make baseline selection explicit in every ledger/release/CLI so later repairs cannot accidentally use historical source geometry.
- Add only source-supported candidate portions allowed by the common rule. Existing assigned cells cannot change owner or become empty; source-water/conflicting-owner cells and stale/incomplete evidence fail before publication. Complete relevant neighbor exclusion and source/query rosters are mandatory. Every candidate yields accepted, zero-native-cell, or explicit rejected/unknown disposition; none disappears. Any eligibility-policy change requires a distinct rule-version review, not repetitive case approvals.
- Preserve base GeoJSON as its original valid complete geometry. Use an explicitly versioned base-plus-additions effective-footprint record/ledger for shared-edge additions; each primitive and its original byte/inverse proof remain complete. This is a set of primitives, NOT an invalid GeoJSON geometry. Prefer existing valid Polygon/MultiPolygon assembly when it actually passes. Unsupported GeoJSON/GIS consumers must fail closed rather than read only the base.
- Feed the same effective primitives to unchanged exact native row methods and continuous membership. Drawing, boundary generation and picking use the same authoritative native ownership product. Projected fallback must not silently render repaired releases: retained Canadian/Alaska baseline coast centres already differ between projected and native methods. Test old ownership preservation, effective continuous membership, primitive seam/boundary rules and both actual renderer/picker dispatch paths; native-only success is incomplete.
- Bind the effective footprint, full original base archive, additive ledger/rule version, before/after complete identities, source receipts, native assets and source digest into an explicit reversible reference release. Legacy non-additive release hashes remain unchanged. Preserve original source-date/fitness/water/admin/history limits in receipts and allow restoring every original base and prior owner product. No live pointer/publisher/provider operation is included.

Three-PR delivery
1. Common rule/ledger + source-bound batch producer and exact effective-footprint reader, complete original inverse, rejection/exception and unchanged-base controls. No active consumers/pointers switched.
2. Native runtime/context and continuous membership plus drawing/picking integration. Keep original numerical row algorithm and scientific comparison methods literal. Actual primitive seam, assigned-pixel preservation, water/conflict/stale/ambiguous evidence controls and complete unchanged context/owner closures. Supported legacy features remain compatible.
3. Release/compact-context/source-digest and explicit GIS-reader handling, durable actual guarded staged repair CLI/instructions, complete original inverse/readback, fresh repeated batch executions, applicable normal build/regression and distinct exact-head substantive review. Confirm rules advance later batches without per-case software edits or repeated approval requests.

Validation and honest pilot
Reuse immutable accepted #1295 old/gain/new pointsets as real legacy integration regressions and the merged #1521/#1508 Alaska source-only packet as required rejected/unsupported regressions. Neither rewrites the accepted fixes nor autoapproves Alaska thirteen. The active #1520 three-Arctic integration owns its existing factual scope; coordinate baseline and consumer helpers and do not edit its packet. New pilot rows must satisfy the reviewed reusable rule mechanically; all nonmatching rows are preserved exceptions. Model controls are explicitly synthetic and cannot establish source authority. Run no new global audit/source acquisition. Report components, positive geometric gains, actual newly assigned native cells (including zero), conflicts/unknowns, complete bytes, RSS/time and measured batch throughput separately.

Required gates
Follow current AGENTS, WORKER_COORDINATION, LOCAL_WORKSPACES, AUDIT_FAILURE_PREVENTION, PREMERGE_EVIDENCE_REVIEW, ISSUE_LIFECYCLE and STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION. Separate author/reviewer identities and fresh bounded sparse worktrees. Prospectively admit complete unique raw+decoded inputs/runtime/code/output for each genuine phase: ordinary file/decoded member <=32 MiB, phase <=256 MiB and <=512 descriptors; preserve all attempts and publish receipts last. Use shared consumed-input, safe fresh destination, full scope/join and callable/source guards. Actual scoped cold entry adverse controls, two fresh complete producer executions with whole encoded/decoded equality, normal applicable CI, exact-head reviewed machine manifest and one serialized queue request per PR lifecycle. No cap escape or hidden body/geometry replacement. Final closure means this reusable system and end-to-end staged integration work, not all world gaps physically resolved or a deployed website.

Engineering subject declarations are empty because this work delivers a mechanism, not a new geographic authority decision. The packet must independently bind every actual pilot reference/component/source ID; synthetic mechanism subjects must never masquerade as geographic references. The completed factual #1520 repair remains separately owned.


Scope clarification (2026-10-08): `src/data-client.js` is the actual `loadGeography` release-loading boundary. It must explicitly select and authenticate the effective base-plus-additions adapter and its native assets; changing only map drawing/picking would leave a release-loading mismatch. This one demonstrated consumer path is added to owned scope. Existing declared additive-release/consumer tests cover the caller; no broader data namespace or extra test path is added. The author has canonically released the old claim (result 6070206635); shared readiness and holder reclaim with the revised exact prefix array are required before editing the added path. All original source, ownership, scientific, review, release and no-deployment constraints remain unchanged.


2026-10-08 review-metadata correction: the original root prototype handover is a preserved local diagnostic source (6,357 bytes; SHA-256 `da994c655ba43b0d648fc5b3a9ecb289fa69584f8cc4790a862bbf5a02554a69`), not a committed ancestor baseline file. The erroneous `prototype_handover_sha256` machine baseline pin is removed; retain the exact original handover as an archived candidate source with its actual provenance and hash, without inventing an ancestor. The three real immutable ancestor baseline pins, all original source/identity/geometry/history custody, scientific limits, repair eligibility, scope and acceptance remain unchanged. The holder canonically released claim `c79f6ba1-07d6-4341-a1cb-e82ba9665fb6` before this correction (accepted result 6071156997); normal readiness and claim revalidation must precede resumed author work.


2026-10-08 continuation after PR1547 merged: preserve the complete original additive mechanism/pilot packet at its original execution vintages. The next fresh branch is engineering/additive-native-gap-batch-20261008 with its own added evidence namespace and manifest. This is the already-required true shared multi-component producer: complete retained Alaska thirteen-case roster, typed original ADM2/2018 county provenance, combined deterministic ledger/patch and native/conflict/current-owner exclusions with reasoned assigned, zero-cell and exception outputs. Eleven retained source-predicate passes are not eleven geographic approvals or native repair counts; two parent exceptions remain explicit. All prior owned paths, three baseline pins, original acceptance, max-three-PR budget and no-activation/publication/source-authority constraints remain. The prior holder canonically released its claim before this narrow namespace/manifest amendment (accepted result6072188231); readiness and a fresh matching-branch claim precede implementation.


### Explicit reusable rule composition and selected-release contract (2026-10-09)

Actual retained v1 evidence exposed a scalability defect: the add031 pilot ledger binds rule `f08ddf9c1d0534aecda36ff134d6398d48c618a7e6982e7f51c31914c2140faf`, while the Alaska batch binds `199f6e33cf394fe92dd490100a717eb23c008cbe896f69ac01e36f49e2f6d8a6`. These hashes bind batch evidence, including case rosters/input paths and proposal executed-code. They are not stable generic eligibility-policy identifiers. Existing v1 footprint, digest and ledger comparison require one global rule hash; therefore a comparator-only relaxation would be unsafe and would still fail to compose future batches. Preserve all original v1 bodies, proofs, methods and strict legacy behavior.

The remaining third delivery must use an explicit versioned v2 composition path where needed: each accepted or zero-cell component retains its exact original primitive, target/index/base geometry, source receipt and original rule/preimage/authority binding. An append-only, sorted whole authority/rule registry authenticates every complete original rule preimage and complete source/proposal request, qualified facts, inventory, publication and operating receipts. Reconstruct the actual preimage version: Alaska's version3 includes proposal executed_code and native method in addition to source_rule. Do not replace this with hash(source_rule) or infer approval from hashes/booleans. Semantic policy identity/version must come from trusted supported profile authority; an actual predicate-policy change still requires distinct version review.

A separate registry aggregate digest may change when independently authenticated entries are appended. Conservation must preserve every old per-component primitive/zero-cell contribution/source authority and every old registry entry exactly, rather than demanding that a whole batch's changing aggregate remain equal. Explicit v2 ledger, effective-footprint and effective-digest dispatch must agree in producer, native loader, continuous membership, rendering/picking, source explanations and trusted prevention. V1 remains literal and cannot silently accept mixed rules. Never relabel an old batch execution hash as a new stable policy ID.

Agree one optional committed `additive_release:{path,bytes,sha256}` selector pointing to a typed sidecar, while preserving the native selector's base fields and base registry. The sidecar binds the exact base selection, existing `retained-native-base-plus-delta-v1` runtime envelope where supported (preserve its strict eight-key additiveRelease shape), complete four-asset logical-to-ordinary payload mapping and full source/proposal authority pins. All physical ordinary Git locations and encoded/decoded inverse/costs must be real. No scanning unselected proposals. No selected hook, selector/runtime edit or activation occurs before coordinated claim/path ownership and actual N2 selection/readback; #1520 currently owns that selector. This is an agreed future interface, not a claim that the staged v8/a71/b9 pilot is valid against v9.

Reuse original source decisions; genuinely rebind the staged cases to the actual selected N2 bank and complete current owner/native/effective/neighbor domain before any selection. Do not repeat source research or relabel old executions. The two parent exceptions and all unknowns remain unchanged. Normal complete phased admission, source/callable/method guards, repeated qualified output equality, distinct exact-head review, hosted/combined checks, normal queue/readback/cleanup and original max-three-PR budget remain. This correction adds no cases, source authority, proximity filling, tolerance, cap waiver, production write or deployment permission.
